content: {"summary":"Users report that their chosen tracks are frequently replaced by unrelated songs, disrupting listening sessions.[#rv_4877225128663681837] The issue escalates over time, with some users experiencing random samples instead of full tracks.[#rv_-7589450099845676560] Playlists lose control as the app auto‑switches to external or sample tracks, even after manual selection.[#rv_1948492864084987853] Repeated playback attempts often result in different songs, and the app fails to resume the original track after completion.[#rv_3330890961785893525] Overall, the feature causes frustration, leading to negative reviews and a 94% dissatisfaction rate.[#rv_8299858959123806415]"}
